bullets.text: Corporation officials trying to prevent encroachments in the Pallikaranai marshland in Velachery were driven away by a mysterious group.

Sunil Kumar Gupta will spearhead investment, solar and AI initiatives at the Vibrant Goa Global Business Summit 2026.
The Vice-President urged medical institutions to strengthen research and embrace emerging healthcare technologies.
